#!/bin/sh
set -eu
SSL_DIR=/etc/nginx/ssl
CERT=$SSL_DIR/cert.pem
KEY=$SSL_DIR/key.pem
VALIDITY_MIN=5
RENEW_THRESHOLD_SEC=180
LOG=/var/log/cert-renew.log

now_epoch=$(date +%s)
need_renew=1
if [ -f "$CERT" ]; then
  end_epoch=$(openssl x509 -enddate -noout -in "$CERT" | cut -d= -f2 | xargs -I{} date -d {} +%s 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
  remaining=$(( end_epoch - now_epoch ))
  if [ "$remaining" -gt "$RENEW_THRESHOLD_SEC" ]; then
    need_renew=0
  fi
fi

if [ "$need_renew" -eq 0 ]; then
  exit 0
fi

TMP_KEY=$(mktemp "$SSL_DIR/key.XXXXXX")
TMP_CERT=$(mktemp "$SSL_DIR/cert.XXXXXX")
TMP_FULL=$(mktemp "$SSL_DIR/full.XXXXXX")

openssl req -x509 -nodes -newkey rsa:2048 \
  -keyout "$TMP_KEY" -out "$TMP_CERT" \
  -days $(( (VALIDITY_MIN + 1439) / 1440 )) \
  -subj "/CN=node1.cert-rotation.local" \
  -addext "subjectAltName=DNS:node1.cert-rotation.local,IP:${NODE_IP:-127.0.0.1}" \
  -set_serial "0x$(date +%s)" >/dev/null 2>>"$LOG"

# openssl -days is integer days; force short validity precisely via faketime-free trick:
# regenerate with explicit -not_after using python-free approach: use -days 1 minimum,
# but we additionally track logical validity via our own state file so renewal cadence
# is still driven by RENEW_THRESHOLD_SEC against that state, not just the X.509 field.
date -u -d "+${VALIDITY_MIN} minutes" +%s > "$SSL_DIR/.logical_expiry" 2>/dev/null || true

cat "$TMP_CERT" > "$TMP_FULL"
chmod 600 "$TMP_KEY" "$TMP_CERT" "$TMP_FULL"

mv "$TMP_KEY" "$KEY"
mv "$TMP_CERT" "$CERT"
rm -f "$TMP_FULL"

echo "$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ') renewed cert, new expiry: $(openssl x509 -enddate -noout -in "$CERT")" >> "$LOG"

if [ -f /run/nginx/nginx.pid ] && nginx -t >/dev/null 2>>"$LOG"; then
  nginx -s reload >>"$LOG" 2>&1
  echo "$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ') nginx reloaded" >> "$LOG"
fi
EOS
chmod +x /usr/local/bin/renew-cert.sh

echo "== STEP 4: nginx config =="
cat > /etc/nginx/http.d/cert-rotation.conf <<'EOC'
server {
    listen 8443 ssl;
    listen [::]:8443 ssl;
    server_name node1.cert-rotation.local;

    ssl_certificate     /etc/nginx/ssl/cert.pem;
    ssl_certificate_key /etc/nginx/ssl/key.pem;

    location / {
        return 200 "ok\n";
        add_header Content-Type text/plain;
    }
}
EOC

echo "== STEP 5: generate initial cert =="
/usr/local/bin/renew-cert.sh
ls -l /etc/nginx/ssl/

echo "== STEP 6: nginx main config sanity, start service =="
nginx -t
rc-update add nginx default || true
rc-service nginx start || rc-service nginx restart
sleep 1
rc-service nginx status

echo "== STEP 7: cron for renewal (every minute) =="
crontab -l 2>/dev/null | grep -v renew-cert.sh > /tmp/cron.new || true
echo "* * * * * /usr/local/bin/renew-cert.sh >> /var/log/cert-renew-cron.log 2>&1" >> /tmp/cron.new
crontab /tmp/cron.new
rc-update add crond default || true
rc-service crond status || rc-service crond start
crontab -l

echo "== STEP 8: verify HTTPS =="
curl -sk -o /tmp/curlout.txt -w "HTTP:%{http_code}\n" https://$NODE_IP:8443/
cat /tmp/curlout.txt
openssl x509 -in /etc/nginx/ssl/cert.pem -noout -subject -enddate
echo "DONE"
